description: A municipal waiting room that has perfected the art of the almost-served: a ticket machine that dispenses a number you'll never hear called, a rank of bolted chairs, and a long counter behind scratched security glass. A cork wall bristles with day-work tabs and a laminated GRIEVANCE PROCEDURE that is, itself, a grievance. The whole room smells of toner and municipal patience.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window

name: Office of Permitted Suffering
